description: GPS speed, motion-state logger and waypoints for vehicles (port of the JP226 ESP32 logger)

store.summary: GPS logger with motion sensing, waypoint photos and vehicle setup
store.description: Logs GPS tracks to daily CSV files using the JP226 ESP32 logger's timing and unchanged 63-column telemetry schema. Reads the CardputerZero BMI270 IMU, captures an optional camera photo for each waypoint, and records road, surface, tyre pressure, suspension and load settings in the existing waypoint CSV. Includes speed, GPS, IMU, logger, waypoint, setup, diagnostics, version and Dino Dash pages. OBD-II remains an optional future extension.
